name: Octop
description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
one_liner: A private, self-hosted alternative to ChatGPT that a whole company can share, multiple people and multiple AI agents, all running on infrastructure the company controls instead of a public cloud service.
buyer: An IT manager at a mid-size company who wants to give the whole team AI chat access without sending company data to an external AI vendor.
business_use_cases: A company replaces per-seat ChatGPT Enterprise licenses with a self-hosted deployment it fully controls and customizes.
An MSP offers 'private company AI assistant' as a new service line for clients worried about data leaving their network.
A regulated industry (finance, healthcare) deploys it in-house to get AI assistance while staying compliant with data-residency rules.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed deployment and hosting for companies that want it private but don't want to run servers themselves
Sell setup and integration consulting connecting it to a company's internal tools

steal_this: This weekend, deploy it for one small company as a trial 'private AI assistant,' and pitch a monthly managed-hosting fee once they're hooked.
